metadata.title: IngreFit — AI Food Scanner for Your Goals
metadata.description: Scan a barcode or food label and get a factual, personalized 10-point fit score for your nutrition goals.

hero.title: A food scanner that asks one useful question:
hero.subtitle: Scan a barcode. IngreFit reads available product facts and explains them for your goals on a clear 10-point scale.

how.title: Point, read, understand
how.subtitle: The app uses the fastest reliable source first, then asks for evidence when the database is incomplete.
how.step1Body: We check Open Food Facts for identity, ingredients, nutrition, allergens, Nutri-Score and NOVA data.
how.step2Body: If the product is missing or incomplete, photograph the front, ingredients and nutrition table.
how.step3Body: A deterministic 1–10 score uses only available facts and the goals you selected. AI explains the result in your device language.

principle.title: AI reads and explains. It never fills the blanks.
principle.body: Unknown stays unknown. Nutrition values are never guessed. Allergens are never marked absent just because the field is empty. The score and its evidence remain visible together.
principle.fact1Body: Open Food Facts or visible package text creates the factual layer. AI cannot add to it.
principle.fact2Body: Goal rules calculate the score before AI writes a single sentence.
principle.fact3Body: You see the exact declared number, classification or ingredient behind each plus or minus.

personal.title: Personal beats generic
personal.body: The same cereal may score well for a high-fiber goal and poorly for someone limiting sugar. Your goals, eating pattern, allergens and avoid list change the explanation — never the underlying facts.

features.title: Made for the supermarket aisle
features.f1Body: Open Food Facts first, with backend caching that respects public API limits.
features.f2Body: Three guided photos give AI only the evidence it needs to transcribe the package.
features.f3Body: Update your goals, diet and flagged ingredients any time from Profile.
features.f4Body: Recent product results stay on your device for quick comparison.
features.f5Body: The interface follows the device; explanations request the full device language tag.
features.f6Body: See today’s used and remaining analyses before you scan.

pricing.title: Start free. Scan more when you need it.
pricing.premiumFeature3: Built for frequent shopping and comparisons
pricing.note: Limits reset daily. Store pricing will be displayed in the app before purchase.

cta.title: Read the package. Understand the choice.
cta.body: IngreFit is being prepared for iOS and Android. Leave your email to hear when early access opens.

footer.tagline: Personal food clarity, grounded in visible facts.
footer.disclaimer: IngreFit provides general information, not medical advice. Always verify the package for allergies and medical conditions.
footer.off: Product data may come from Open Food Facts, a crowdsourced database whose data is not guaranteed to be complete or accurate.

legal.privacyIntro: This starter policy describes the intended IngreFit data flow. Replace the controller details and have counsel review it before release.
legal.privacyDataBody: Goals, diet preferences and scan history are stored locally by default. The server receives an installation identifier, selected goals, a device language tag and either a barcode or package images required for the requested analysis.
legal.privacyImagesBody: Label images are sent to the configured AI provider only to extract visible product facts and produce the requested result. Define and disclose your production retention period before launch.
legal.privacyThirdBody: The backend may contact Open Food Facts, Google Gemini, hosting, quota storage and billing providers. Their terms and privacy practices also apply.
legal.privacyRightsBody: Users can remove local history by clearing application data. Add account deletion and data-request contact workflows if user accounts are introduced.
legal.termsIntro: These starter terms must be adapted to your company, billing terms and launch countries before publication.
legal.termsInfoBody: Scores and explanations are general product information and are not medical, dietary or professional advice. Users must verify product packaging, especially for allergies or health conditions.
legal.termsDataBody: Open Food Facts is crowdsourced and may be incomplete, outdated or inaccurate. Product packaging is the controlling source.
legal.termsBillingBody: Free includes up to 5 completed product analyses per day; Premium includes up to 50. Final store prices, renewal, cancellation and refund terms must be shown before purchase.
legal.termsAcceptBody: Do not automate abusive traffic, evade quotas, probe protected routes, upload unrelated or unlawful images, or interfere with the service.
